subject: AWS co-sell: BlueNova Health — stakeholder rotation & mutual action timeline
messages:
From: Sara Williams <sara.williams@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: BlueNova Health intro + MA plan

Marcus —

Quick intro: I’m Sara (AWS Partner Manager) and I’m working with BlueNova Health (they run telehealth and care coordination) — they indicated strong interest in a Redwood deployment for inference powering clinical summarization and triage. They’re asking for a joint account plan and a short exec intro next week.

Would you be able to lead the Redwood side for the initial MA (mutual action) plan? Key asks from AWS/BlueNova:
- 30–45m exec + technical intro with decision roster
- joint success milestones and procurement runway (PO vs subscription)
- checklist for security/compliance evidence (SOC2, retention)

I attached the AWS co-sell onboarding guide to help with the ask. Can you confirm technical point-of-contact at Redwood and availability for a call 10/22–10/25?

Sara
AWS Partner Solutions
Attachment: AWS_CoSell_Onboarding_Guide.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Williams <sara.williams@amazon.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: BlueNova Health intro + MA plan

Sara / all —

Thanks — happy to own the Redwood side for this. Proposed quick mutual action plan below (first draft):

1) Exec intro + demo (30–45m) — goal: align business sponsor, procurement, and technical owners — target 10/22 10:00–10:45 PT
2) Technical deep-dive (60m) — model mapping, latency/SLA targets, data flow & VPC options — target week of 10/25
3) Security questionnaire & evidence — we’ll provide SOC2 and network diagrams; request BlueNova controls list by 10/29
4) Commercial runway — initial PO vs monthly hosted plan; aim to get procurement decision by 11/12

Open items I need from AWS/BlueNova: exec roster for the intro, preferred demo duration, and any specific PII/PHI concerns.

Attaching a short MA plan stub for review. I’ll loop in Kar thik for procurement cadence and Laura for marketplace listing/ops readout. Vanessa — can you surface the catalog listing status and any listing prerequisites?

Next steps: Sara to confirm attendees; I’ll send calendar invite and SOW draft following that.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales — West
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RNW_BlueNova_MA_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 286KB)

Marcus — quick notes inline / bullets: 

- Add a security deliverables column to the MA plan: SOC2 report (we can share in 48h), encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM options for Private deploys.
- Procurement: ask BlueNova for preferred contract vehicle (SaaS subscription vs reserved Dedicated commit). If they want Dedicated we’ll need a 60–90 day lead.
